stem.text: Proteases are a group of enzymes that digest proteins.
Which statements about proteases are correct?

items: A bacterial protease that is secreted from a disease-causing bacterium could act as an antibody and cause the production of antigens against it.
Non-competitive inhibition of a protease that has an optimum condition of pH2 can be overcome by increasing the substrate concentration and increasing the pH.
Water molecules are required when peptide bonds that link the monomers together are broken by the action of proteases in hydrolysis reactions.
